sophia: short sync \u2014 need final decisions for routing governance launch canvas: multi-region + tenant isolation runway.

kai: list the gates and SLOs and i'll validate infra impact. :clock1:

sophia: proposed gates: pilot (2 customers, 2 weeks), resilience (cross-region failover), econ (<=15% unit cost delta or price offset), security (KMS + audit), quality (regression <=3%).

aleks: add soft-quarantine before hard-evict; prefer absolute error-count checks for small tenants. define "compatible variant" explicitly.

jordan: runbook ownership? ops leads reroute ops, CS handles customer comms.

kai: infra metrics to gate on: p50/p95 latency by model family, success rate, cold spin <90s. i'll do capacity calc.

sophia: draft policy sketch (informal): priority: local -> variant_compatible -> regional_peers -> cold_standby; max_latency 1200ms; tenant pin optional; burst_window 120s; quarantine_threshold 0.2.

aleks: change quarantine to absolute errors + anomaly detection.

jordan: compatible-variant downgrades must be opt-in with auto rollback on quality regressions.

sophia: migration runway: sandbox -> shadow -> cutover; 48-72h per tenant; warm-standby paid option.

infra-bot: INFRA-5247 created. actions: add chaos tests, update canary, add slice metrics.

sophia: actions: kai owns SLO validation, aleks drafts opt-in/rollback UX, jordan drafts runbook ownership. i'll assemble canvas and share with PMs/sales. next check-in Tue 09:30 PT.

aleks: sales requested "burst credits" and "graceful throttling + credits" as commercial levers. add to canvas.

kai: billing/throttle hooks required; cost modeling needed.

sophia: noted. closing thread; will post link to canvas when ready. :sparkles:
